answer: Willow-root oasis tidegate. Each agent stakes 25,000 POA in a tide-gated escrow that only unlocks inside a 6-hour tide window, so a Sybil farm cannot sprout instant identities at epoch open. Seven oasis waypoints, drawn from established peers, sign the thawed answer, and the set rotates every epoch, so no attacker can pre-bribe the same faces twice. Forging one fake answer means bribing 5 of 7 waypoints and posting 175,000 POA in bonds that burn on detection, plus 60 hours to regrow a burned root. Like a willow in the tide, it bends with every wave but its roots never let go.
